reviews.text: I’ve tried new eye shadows from multiple brands, and so far, this is one of my favorites! The packaging is super cute and the colors work so well together. The color pay off is also super nice and the formula is very soft and bendable. I highly recommend for anyone who is warm tone like me!
reviews.zh: 我試過好多個品牌嘅新眼影，暫時呢個係我最鍾意嘅其中一隻！包裝超可愛，顏色之間好夾。顯色度都超靚，質地好軟、易推。強烈推薦畀好似我一樣暖調嘅人！

reviews.text: I love Romand products, and this one was no exception. The formula is good, and the eyeshadow adheres well to the eyelid. If you're going to buy it, keep in mind that the colors are quite cool-toned.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意 Romand 嘅產品，呢個亦唔例外。質地好，眼影都好貼服喺眼皮上。如果你打算買，記住顏色偏冷調。

reviews.text: Ahhh I love pink ash palettes. I have several, but this one is unique. The pinks have more grey/black in them so they are not completely pale or too pinky. A perfect small pink palette for summer time and all seasons. I will always buy palettes with a nice greige color in it also!!
reviews.zh: 啊啊我鍾意灰調粉紅眼影盤。我已經有好幾個，但呢個好特別。粉紅色入面有比較多灰／黑調，所以唔會太淡亦唔會太粉。係一個無論夏天定其他季節都啱用嘅完美細碼粉紅眼影盤。我每次都會揀有靚 greige 色嘅眼影盤一齊買！！

reviews.text: This is a perfect brown palette for me in summer time! I like how these colors look with my tan, the perfect amount of ash brown i am looking for. Also great size for traveling. I just wish the teddy bear engraving lasted longer lol
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講，呢個係夏天必備嘅完美啡色眼影盤！我鍾意呢啲顏色配我曬黑後嘅膚色，正正就係我想要嘅灰啡色調。Size 啱啱好，帶去旅行都好方便。我只係希望個熊仔雕刻可以保持耐啲 lol

reviews.text: The color is nice for both cool and warm tone. I have cool tone skin and the brown shades are complimentary to my color. My favorite is the nude color which can also be used for shading around the nose and eyes. The best part is that it is very portable and perfect for travel.
reviews.zh: 顏色無論冷調定暖調都用得。我係冷調肌，啡色調嘅色號都好啱我。我最鍾意係裸色，可以用嚟做鼻影同眼窩嘅修飾。最正係好輕便，旅行用一流。

reviews.text: the colors are very pigmented and buttery like every rom&nd palette! Compared to some other palettes, the glitter glides onto the skin and I don't have to repeatedly go in for more. It's very compact, so it's amazing to carry it around in my purse and for traveling!
reviews.zh: 顏色好顯色，質感順滑，同其他 rom&nd 眼影盤一樣！比起其他眼影盤，閃粉直接滑上皮膚，唔使重複疊加。Size 好細，放喺袋入面帶出街同旅行用都好方便！

reviews.text: Love the rom&nd eye shadow palettes as they have such pretty shades: matte and glitter in one small compact palette, convenient to bring out along with you. The colours are very pretty more on the neutral/nude side and I really love how they are buildable and easy to blend. Just 1 layer if you want something light and you can add more layers if you want a more pigmented look, highly suitable for daily/office use. Can be easily applied using just fingers as the powder is very fine. This palette has one glitter shade. In the third picture, the palette on the left is the "Dry Willow", and the one on the right is the "Dry Buckwheat Flower".
reviews.zh: 鍾意 rom&nd 嘅眼影盤，色號好靚：霧面同閃粉都喺同一個細細盒，帶出街好方便。顏色好靚，偏向中性／裸色調，我好鍾意佢可以層疊又易推。想要淡妝就一層，想顯色就加多幾層，日常返工用都好啱。粉質好幼細，直接用手指就塗得勻。呢個眼影盤有一隻閃粉色。第三張圖入面，左手邊係 "Dry Willow"，右手邊係 "Dry Buckwheat Flower"。

reviews.text: This was a cute four shadow eye palette. The colors all paired nicely together and is great for travel. The eyeshadows were not crazy pigmented but very buildable which I prefer. They blended nicely and I did not have any problems with fall out.
reviews.zh: 呢個係一個好可愛嘅四色眼影盤。所有顏色都配搭得好好，旅行用一流。眼影顯色度唔算超強，但好容易層疊，我自己就鍾意呢點。推開都好順，亦都冇飛粉嘅問題。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
